Q00060_GoodWorksReward/32487-06.html.text: Mark: Uh... You were lucky to have defeated them this time, but others will come for me. I am poisoned and can't move. Here, take this bloody cloth and find out what kind of poison it is, then bring me the antidote. Go see Daeger and he'll tell you what to do. If you want to help me, please hurry!

Q00060_GoodWorksReward/32487-07.html.text: Mark: Oh... Did you bring the antidote? I can't move anymore. If you want to help me, please find the antidote!

Q00060_GoodWorksReward/32487-09.html.text: Mark: Uhh... Fortunately, the others haven't come for me yet. Give me the antidote! I am so weak I can't even move...

Q00060_GoodWorksReward/32487-04.html.text: Mark: I am...Mark. My name is Mark. Here...it's too dangerous for you here. Leave now! Too late... Behind you...watch out behind you!

Q00060_GoodWorksReward/32487-05.html.text: Mark: Uhh... (Another is already carrying out the quest. Continue the conversation later.)

Q00060_GoodWorksReward/32487-10.html.text: Mark: You saved my life! But it's too dangerous for either of us here. Go to Daeger and I will contact you there. Farewell!
